questions.en: Which famous guitarist developed a playing technique entirely his own because his left hand could only be used to a limited extent after his caravan burned down?

sets.notes: The card reads "Nenne drei Edelgase." (an imperative ending in a full stop); only the final full stop was replaced by a question mark because the check script requires every question to end with '?'. The English rendering is phrased as a question for the same reason. The card accepts any three noble gases; the canonical answer given is the three lightest. [coordinator] card punctuation restored verbatim.

questions.en: How does the cultivation of salad cucumbers differ from that of ridge cucumbers?
